prompt.text: Do these steps in order, briefly: 1) Read math.ts. 2) Use Grep to find 'add' in this folder. 3) Use Glob for *.ts. 4) Edit math.ts to add an exported subtract(a, b) function below add. 5) Run the shell command: git status --short. 6) Run the shell command: git definitely-not-a-command (it will fail; that's expected). 7) Use the Task tool to start a subagent that reads README.md and reports its first line. Then reply DONE.
